title: Cardinality bound for odd-wise independence
statement: Let $n>0$, let $k$ be an odd natural number, and let $A$ be a nonempty finite multiset of sign vectors in $\{-1,1\}^n$ whose associated density has every nonconstant Fourier coefficient of degree at most $k$ equal to zero. Then $\displaystyle \sum_{j=0}^{(k-1)/2}\binom{n}{j}+\binom{n-1}{(k-1)/2}\le |A|$, where $|A|$ counts multiset elements.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is indexed by a finite nonempty type
the sign-vector multiset is $k$-wise independent in the stated Fourier sense
